description: This Java source file defines the AuthorizedAnnotationAttributes class, which provides metadata handling for @Authorized annotations used for security and authorization within the OpenMRS platform. It includes methods to retrieve authorization attributes, check annotation presence, and determine privilege require-all behavior for classes and methods. The class interacts mainly with Java annotations, reflection, and collection utilities.

classes.name: AuthorizedAnnotationAttributes
classes.description: Provides methods to obtain and evaluate @Authorized annotation attributes for classes, methods, and fields to facilitate security authorization logic.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves authorization attributes as strings for a given class or method based on @Authorized annotations.

methods.name: getRequireAll
methods.description: Checks if the @Authorized annotation on a class or method requires all privileges.

methods.name: hasAuthorizedAnnotation
methods.description: Determines if a method is annotated with @Authorized.
